note: Village of Strum campground on a wooded point in Crystal Lake, an impoundment of the Buffalo River, beside the village's 9-hole golf course and ballfields. Sites have cable TV; boat landing, volleyball and pickleball courts. The Buffalo River State Trail (ATV, snowmobile, horse) passes nearby. Part of the campground is let by the season, and units may be stored over winter on sites 22-42. --Claude
summary: Village page confirms 42 sites with water/electric/cable (some sewer: 22-42), showers, dump, season Apr 1-Oct 31, phone/text booking. Latest posted rates are 2025 ($30/$33). Lakeview kept (filtered view through a shoreline shrub/tree fringe). strumcampground.com is a for-sale domain. Seasonal share not measurable.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. The village page says 'Shade trees & Crystal lake frontage'. On Esri imagery units on the point's south-west side (~44.5560,-91.3818) sit ~15-25 m from the water behind a band of shoreline trees and brush; units on the north-east row (~44.5567,-91.3805) sit ~22-30 m back across lawn with a fringe of shrubs and trees along the shore. No site numbers are published and no pad is shown on open ground to the water, so no upgrade; a filtered view holds. The south-west and north-east rows both look like set-up seasonal units.

SEASONAL SHARE (village-owned, flagged for the reviewer): not measurable. The village publishes a Seasonal Campsite Agreement and seasonal/annual rates for every site ($2,000-2,300), and lets seasonal units stay over winter on sites 22-42. Imagery shows about 25 set-up units on 42 sites. Google Maps 4.4 from 61 reviews. Nightly rates are posted ($30/$33) with phone booking, so tests 1-3 pass; the share of nights sold could not be shown.
